name: Finset
sum_le_card_nsmul
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.sum f ≤ s.card • n
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.sum f ≤ s.card • n
result.informal_name: Sum over Finite Set Bounded by Cardinality Times Maximum Element
result.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $N$ equipped with a partial order $\leq$ where addition is left-monotonic, given a finite set $s$, a function $f : \iota \to N$, and an element $n \in N$, if $f(x) \leq n$ for all $x \in s$, then the sum of $f(x)$ over all $x \in s$ is less than or equal to the product of the cardinality of $s$ and $n$. Symbolically, $\sum_{x \in s} f(x) \leq |s| \cdot n$.

name: Cardinal
sum_le_iSup
result.signature: ∀ {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{u}), Cardinal.sum f ≤ Cardinal.mk ι * ⨆ i, f i
result.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{u}), Cardinal.sum f ≤ Cardinal.mk ι * ⨆ i, f i
result.informal_description: For any type $\iota$ and function $f : \iota \to \text{Card}$, the cardinal sum of $f$ is less than or equal to the product of the cardinality of $\iota$ and the supremum of the values of $f$ over $\iota$. Symbolically, $\sum_{i \in \iota} f(i) \leq |\iota| \cdot \sup_{i \in \iota} f(i)$.

name: Finset
card_nsmul_le_sum
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → s.card • n ≤ s.sum f
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → s.card • n ≤ s.sum f
result.informal_name: Cardinality times element is less than or equal to sum over finite set
result.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of type $\iota$ and function $f : \iota \to N$ where $N$ is an additive commutative monoid equipped with a partial order and left addition monotonicity, if every element $x \in s$ satisfies $n \leq f(x)$, then the scalar multiplication of the cardinality of $s$ by $n$ is less than or equal to the sum of $f$ over $s$. Formally, $|s| \cdot n \leq \sum_{x \in s} f(x)$.

name: Multiset
sum_le_card_nsmul
result.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [AddLeftMono α] (s : Multiset α) (n : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ∈ s → x ≤ n) → s.sum ≤ s.card • n
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [AddLeftMono α] (s : Multiset α) (n : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ∈ s → x ≤ n) → s.sum ≤ s.card • n
result.informal_name: Multiset Sum Bounded by Cardinality and Upper Bound
result.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $M$ equipped with a partial order $\leq$ and left addition monotonicity, and for any multiset $s$ over $M$ and element $n \in M$, if every element $x$ in $s$ satisfies $x \leq n$, then the sum of the elements in $s$ is less than or equal to the product of the cardinality of $s$ and $n$, i.e., $\sum s \leq |s| \cdot n$.

name: Cardinal
sum_le_iSup_lift
result.signature: ∀ {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{max u v}), Cardinal.sum f ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk ι) * ⨆ i, f i
result.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{max u v}), Cardinal.sum f ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk ι) * ⨆ i, f i
result.informal_description: The cardinal sum of a family of cardinals $ f(i) $ indexed by $ \iota $ is less than or equal to the product of the lifted cardinality of $ \iota $ and the supremum of the family $ f(i) $.
